rooms.subtitle: Design Lodging
rooms.title: Your Nights of Sleep in the Best Comfort
rooms.description: Comfort, simplicity, and hospitality come together to provide an enjoyable and memorable experience for every stay.

suite-double.name: Double Suite
suite-double.description: Comfortable suite with option of a king-size bed or two twin beds, equipped with TV, minibar, and everything you need for a pleasant stay.
suite-double.longDescription: Ideal for couples or friends, our Double Suite offers a cozy and functional setting, with the option of a king-size bed or two twin beds. Equipped with a TV, minibar, and warm decor, it is perfect for resting after a day exploring Fernando de Noronha, providing comfort and practicality throughout your stay.
suite-double.beds: 1 King Size Bed or 2 Single beds

suite-friends.name: Triple Suite
suite-friends.description: Spacious and comfortable suite for up to 3 guests, equipped with TV, minibar, and a cozy atmosphere for a peaceful stay.
suite-friends.longDescription: Perfect for small families or groups of friends, the Triple Suite combines space, comfort, and convenience. Accommodating up to three people, with TV and minibar, it offers an inviting space to relax after a day of sightseeing. Its layout was designed to provide well-being and a highly comfortable stay.

suite-family.name: Family Suite
suite-family.description: Spacious suite for up to 4 guests, with TV, minibar, and all comfort for families and groups.
suite-family.longDescription: Our Family Suite is ideal for families or groups of friends who wish to share special moments in total comfort. Accommodating up to four guests, it features a TV, minibar, and a wide, welcoming space, ensuring practicality and an extremely pleasant stay designed for rest and bonding.

testimonials.subtitle: Guests' Opinion
testimonials.title: What Those Who Have Stayed Say
testimonials.description: Nothing makes us more fulfilled than knowing we could provide moments of peace and rejuvenation for our guests.

1.text: The guesthouse is delightful, the outdoor area is very nice, and the rooms are super comfortable! Plus, all the staff are very sweet.

2.text: My stay at the guesthouse was super comfortable, Katia, Maria, Gil and Jonas were always very attentive and helpful. The breakfast was always made exactly as we wished, leaving us wanting to return, and I will definitely recommend it to my friends, family, and clients in Goiânia. 3.text: The people who make Pousada Liberty what it is are the employees, all of them extremely helpful, attentive, friendly, cheerful... breakfast is always a delight with hot, fresh omelettes and tapiocas. The bed is super comfortable and large. My little one loved the pool and the kittens, even they are friendly. A super special thanks to Gi, Katia, Maria, and Jonas. faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.title: Useful Information for Your Stay

items.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.answer: Check-in begins at 2:00 PM and check-out must be completed by 12:00 PM. If you require early check-in or late check-out, please consult us in advance to check availability and additional fees.

items.question: Does the guesthouse accept pets (Pet Friendly)?
items.answer: We accept small pets (up to 10kg/22lbs) upon prior consultation and acceptance of our pet regulations. We charge a one-time cleaning fee of R$ 120 per stay. Pets should not be left alone in the rooms and are not allowed in the pool area for sanitary reasons.

items.question: Is breakfast included in the rate?
items.answer: Yes, our artisanal breakfast and buffet of cold cuts and fruits is fully included in all rates. It is served daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM in our open lounge overlooking the garden.

items.question: How does the cancellation policy work?
items.answer: Cancellations made up to 45 days prior to the check-in date are eligible for a full refund of the deposit or credit for future stays. Cancellations with less than 45 days' notice or no-shows result in the loss of the deposited amount.

items.question: Do you offer transfer or tour booking services?
items.answer: We do not have our own transfer service, but we have partnerships with trusted, licensed local drivers and rental agencies. We also assist you in booking tours and local guides.
